How does length conversion work?

Length conversion is based on the international definition: 1 inch = 2.54 cm exactly (since 1959). All other units in this tool derive from this base relationship.

  • 1 cm = 10 mm = 0.3937 in
  • 1 inch = 2.54 cm = 25.4 mm
  • 1 foot = 12 in = 30.48 cm = 0.3048 m
  • 1 meter = 100 cm = 39.37 in = 3.281 ft
  • 1 yard = 3 ft = 36 in = 0.9144 m

See our full bra size unit conversion chart .

How to Measure Your Breast Size

Getting an accurate measurement is the first step to finding a bra that truly fits. Here’s a simple method you can do at home with just a soft measuring tape. No advanced tools needed.

Step 1 — Measure your underbust: Stand upright wearing a non-padded bra. Wrap the measuring tape around your ribcage, just under your bust. Make sure it’s snug but not too tight — that’s your band size (underbust measurement). Write down the number.

Step 2 — Measure your bust: Measure around the fullest part of your bust, keeping the tape parallel to the floor. Don’t pull it too tight — this is your bust measurement. The difference between your bust and underbust measurements determines your cup size.

Step 3 — Use our breast calculator: Enter your measurements into the breast calculator above to get your bra size across US, UK, EU, FR, and AU sizing systems instantly. For the most accurate results, measure first thing in the morning and avoid measuring during your menstrual period when breast tissue may be swollen.

For a more detailed walkthrough, check out our complete guide on how to measure bra size at home .

Frequently Asked Questions

How accurate is the conversion?

This converter uses the international standard: 1 inch = 2.54 cm exactly. All conversions are mathematically exact to floating-point precision. The 2-decimal, 3-decimal, and 4-decimal precision options control display rounding only.

What is banker's rounding?

Banker's rounding (also called "round half to even") is the standard in financial and statistical calculations. When the digit to be removed is exactly 5, the result is rounded to the nearest even number. This avoids the upward bias of standard "round half up".

Why do I need 4 decimal places?

4 decimal places (engineering precision) is useful for technical work, sewing patterns, machining tolerances, and other applications where small errors compound. For bra fitting, 2 decimal places is more than sufficient.

Is 1 inch exactly 2.54 cm?

Yes. Since the International Yard and Pound Agreement of 1959, the inch has been defined as exactly 2.54 centimeters. This is the legal definition in the US, UK, and Commonwealth countries.

Can I convert negative or zero values?

The converter accepts any numeric input. Zero converts to zero in all units. Negative values convert to their negative equivalents (useful for coordinate work or directional measurements).

How do I convert centimeters to inches?

To convert centimeters to inches, divide the centimeter value by 2.54. For example, 81 cm ÷ 2.54 = 31.89 inches. Most bra band sizes are rounded to the nearest even inch.

Why is the inch-to-cm conversion important for bra fitting?

Bra sizing uses different measurement systems across regions. US and UK brands typically use inches for band size, while European and Asian brands use centimeters. Knowing both measurements ensures you find the correct bra size regardless of the brand's origin.

What is the formula for length conversion?

The standard formula is: 1 inch = 2.54 centimeters. To convert inches to cm: cm = inches × 2.54 . To convert cm to inches: inches = cm ÷ 2.54 .
